thread:
incident-bot: Pager: embed-service-high-error-rate (P2) — 503 spike observed in us-west for /v1/embeddings. Pager sent to @oncall-primary. Affected customers flagged.
raj: taking this as primary, will own until handoff at 17:55 PT. seeing increased 503s on the ingress.
maria: standing by as secondary, can take handoff at 17:55. ping me if you need escalation.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-115 created. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-503 — start with cache and routing checks.
raj: quick triage: KV cache miss rate jumped ~12% at 16:42 PT, retries spiked, some requests falling to fallback model causing overload. dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/embeddings/latency
lucas: I see one worker node (embeddings-worker-3) with OOM restarts around the same time. I'm going to restart it once we scale to avoid compounding.
raj: mitigation step 1: scaled dedicated embeddings pool +1 replica (nodes up). mitigation step 2: temporarily disabled burst-routing to fallback model. monitoring p95/p99.
maria: noted. FYI customer-impact: estimated 0.6% of production embedding requests returned 503s during the spike. invoice-batcher team notified via customer-notify.
ops-bot: customer-notify: invoice-batcher on-call paged.
raj: applied a local fix — increased redis timeout config per runbook step 4. command used: ```kubectl exec -it svc/emb-cache -- redis-cli config set timeout 300``` — waiting to see stabilisation.
lucas: restarted embeddings-worker-3 gracefully, no crash loops now. keeping logs streaming.
raj: update: 503 rate trending down, back near baseline after ~12m post-mitigation. Still watching for recurrence.
maria: I'll take primary at 17:55 PT. handoff notes: scaling + redis timeout change + disabled fallback routing. If 503s > 1% sustained for 10m, escalate to @eng-platform and open emergency bridge.
lucas: I'll prepare a minimal postmortem stub in the incidents tracker in case we need to expand.
raj: leaving post-handoff note: root cause suspected transient cache evictions combined with an aggressive fallback that amplified load. next steps: eng-platform to review autoscaler config and fallback routing thresholds.
maria: acknowledged and taking over. will keep a 30m watch window then update oncall-summary. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-115 status changed to: Monitoring.
